candidates.review_note: Use shortest arrival times with Dijkstra on nonnegative road lengths. Snow only increases, so arriving earlier at a location can never make a continuation less feasible; later arrivals are dominated and waiting cannot help. Reject a relaxation only when its arrival exceeds the total deadline or the non-exempt destination snow limit. Start and home remain exempt exactly as stated, including start=home, zero snow growth and zero-length roads.

State i means all integer positions1..i are covered. For each antenna, minimally expand it to cover the next uncovered position i+1, paying exactly that expansion and jumping to its new right endpoint. Once a nonempty prefix is covered, extending an antenna covering its rightmost point by1 covers the next point for at most1 additional coin. These unit extensions represent any extra radius beyond a minimal jump, so every optimal choice remains expressible without enumerating radii. Do not use the unit-extension transition at the empty prefix, where no covering antenna has been selected.
